title: Quiet moments
theme: Pure texture with no consequences: a plant, the rain, a delivery bot, a long time on a bench.

storylets.title: An hour on one bench
storylets.note: A person sits for a long time and nothing happens. That is the point.

b1: {A} sits on a bench and watches the street go by.
{A} takes a bench seat and stays for a long while.
{A} sinks onto the slats and does not move.
{A} sits, hands on {A.his} knees, eyes half closed.
b2: {A} stands, stretches, and sits down again.
{A} gets up at last and walks one slow lap around the bench.
{A} rises, rolls both shoulders, and looks up at the sky highway.
{A} stands and brushes off {A.his} coat.

storylets.title: The pond and its small ripples

b1: {A} stands at the edge of the pond and watches the surface.
{A} stops by the water and stays there.
{A} lingers at the rail, chin on {A.his} hands.
{A} stands at the lip of the koi pond, hands in {A.his} pockets.
b2: {A} sits on the stone rim and trails a finger in the water.
{A} takes a seat by the pond and watches the koi turn under the lanterns.
{A} perches on the edge and watches a leaf spin.
{A} sits down on the rim and stays put.

storylets.title: A bowl for one
storylets.note: A solitary meal at a stool.

b1: {A} joins a short line at the stall and reads the board.
{A} orders at the counter without a word, holding up one finger.
{A} orders a plain bowl and pays in coins.
{A} reaches the front and points at the first picture.
b2: {A} eats slowly, eyes on the steam.
{A} eats on the stool, tipping the bowl up at the end.
{A} slurps the last of the broth and sets the bowl down square.
{A} eats quietly and wipes the rim with a thumb.

storylets.title: Following a drone across the roofs
storylets.note: A person watches a drone until it is out of sight.

b1: {A} stops mid-stride and tilts {A.his} head back.
{A} stands in the square and shades {A.his} eyes with a hand.
{A} halts by a planter and follows something overhead.
{A} stands still while the crowd flows around {A.him}.
b2: {A} points up at a cargo drone and says nothing.
{A} gestures toward a drone crossing the roofs.
{A} indicates a drone with one finger and lets {A.his} hand fall.
{A} points at the sky and then at the Data Spire.

storylets.title: Water for the planter
storylets.note: Watering a square planter that nobody asked anyone to water. Cheap and gentle.

b1: {A} sits on a bench beside a planter, a bottle in {A.his} lap.
{A} takes a seat next to a planter, a water bottle in hand, and looks at the dry soil.
{A} perches at the end of the bench, a bottle in one hand, the other on the rim of the planter.
{A} settles on the slats and pulls a bottle from a bag.
b2: {A} tips the bottle over the planter. The soil darkens.
{A} pours a thin stream around the stem of a small tree.
{A} crouches and waters the planter, a little at a time.
{A} empties the bottle into the planter and watches it soak in.

storylets.title: Watching the projector
storylets.note: Sitting on the lawn watching the hologram show.

b1: {A} walks to the lawn and stands at the edge of the glow.
{A} stops at the grass line and looks up.
{A} stands at the back of a small crowd.
{A} stays at the edge of the lawn, a cup in hand.
b2: {A} watches the hologram flicker, {A.his} face lit blue.
{A} stands in the projector's light, mouth slightly open.
{A} watches the show to the end, hands in {A.his} pockets.
{A} stays rooted, eyes tracking a slow-moving figure in light.

b1: {A} stops at a wall of printed sheets and reads each in turn.
{A} reads a flyer for the Sky Mall and a wanted poster.
{A} studies the board with {A.his} arms folded.
{A} reads a notice twice and moves on to the next.
b2: {A} walks on, humming something off-key.
{A} heads off down the block at an easy pace.
{A} moves on, then glances back at the board.
{A} strolls on toward the stalls.

storylets.title: Looking in a shop window
storylets.note: Stopping to look in a window.

b1: {A} stops at the window of {place} and leans toward the glass.
{A} stands in front of a display of bright jackets.
{A} halts at a window and reads the prices.
{A} lingers in front of a case of old radios.
b2: {A} walks on without going in.
{A} moves off down the sidewalk, glancing back once.
{A} walks on, hands in {A.his} pockets.
{A} crosses the street and walks on.

b1: {A} arrives at the sliding doors with a towel over one shoulder.
{A} comes up to the entrance under a drift of steam, yawning.
{A} walks up to the steamy doors with a small bag of bath things.
{A} crosses the street to the baths in slippers.
b2: {A} slips into the bathhouse and the door slides shut.
{A} goes in to soak away the day. Steam leaks from the door.
{A} goes in for a long soak. A cloud drifts out.
{A} enters the bathhouse and does not reappear for an hour.

storylets.title: Waving at nothing
storylets.note: A person waves at a passing delivery bot.

b1: {A} walks along the block with a comm in one hand.
{A} crosses the street at an easy pace.
{A} strolls down the sidewalk with a cup.
{A} heads for the stalls without hurry.
b2: {A} waves at a delivery bot as it rolls by.
{A} waves at someone in a window and gets a wave back.
{A} lifts a hand to an officer on patrol across the street.
{A} waves at a drone that does not wave back.

storylets.title: A bot at a door
storylets.note: Helping a stuck delivery bot, as a stranger.

b1: {A} stops beside a delivery bot waiting at a closed door.
{A} stands over a delivery bot, its light blinking amber.
{A} halts as a delivery bot bumps against {A.his} shin and stops.
{A} stands still and lets a delivery bot nose past.
b2: {A} crouches and picks up a parcel that slid off the bot's tray.
{A} picks a dropped parcel off the sidewalk and sets it back on the bot.
{A} lifts a fallen parcel, squares it on the tray, and steps back.
{A} bends down, scoops up a parcel by the bot's wheels, and puts it back.

storylets.title: Sitting on the platform
storylets.note: Waiting for a train that is on time.

b1: {A} sits on a platform bench with a bag between {A.his} feet.
{A} takes a seat on the platform and watches the arrival board.
{A} sits, one knee over the other, scanning the faces.
{A} perches on the bench and checks {A.his} comm.
b2: {A} boards when the doors slide open.
{A} gets on the train and takes a standing spot by the door.
{A} steps into the train car, and the doors close.
{A} rides away. The platform is empty again.
